notes: SOUND QUALITY PASS. Fixed: on the Pads page your keyboard fired BOTH drums and piano (leftover from the pads move) — pads own the keys there now. Chords through the synth presets sounded harsh because 3-5 full-velocity multi-oscillator voices stacked into clipping: chord notes now share the energy, the live synth voice is trimmed, and a gentle app-wide LIMITER protects everything (jam and studio included). Inconsistent volumes had a measurable cause — the sample banks are mastered ~19dB apart (some peak at 0.07, others at 0.7): every sample is now loudness-NORMALIZED at decode, so switching voices or comp instruments keeps a consistent level.
